prompts.title: Cinematic Silhouette Profile Picture AI Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only as the facial identity and hairstyle reference. Preserve the person’s recognizable identity, natural facial proportions, age, skin tone, hair texture, and distinctive features.

Create a cinematic minimalist profile-picture portrait designed specifically for a social-media DP. Show the person in a clean side-profile silhouette, upper torso and head visible, body angled sideways with the head gently lowered and chin tilted toward the chest, creating a quiet, introspective mood. Keep the facial features mostly hidden in deep shadow while preserving a clearly recognizable profile outline of the forehead, nose, lips, chin, jawline, neck, and hair.

Place the subject against a dramatic glowing cyan/teal-blue background filled with subtle atmospheric fog and soft smoky texture. Position the brightest cyan glow directly behind and around the head to create a strong backlit halo and thin rim light, especially illuminating individual strands around the outer edges of the hair. The subject and clothing should remain almost completely black, with only extremely subtle cool highlights along the shoulders, neck, and hair.

Use high contrast, deep blacks, luminous turquoise/cyan light, soft volumetric haze, cinematic studio backlighting, realistic hair strands, smooth tonal gradients, subtle filmic texture, and premium photographic quality. No visible front light, no brightly illuminated face, no distracting objects, no text.

Compose the portrait inside a large perfect circular crop centered on a clean white/off-white square canvas, with comfortable spacing around the head and shoulders. Keep the subject large enough to remain visually striking when displayed as a small profile picture.

Style: dark cinematic silhouette photography, moody minimalism, mysterious introspective atmosphere, modern premium DP aesthetic, realistic photography, crisp profile contour, polished high-end finish.

Aspect ratio: 1:1.

prompts.title: Monochrome Headphone Profile
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for face and identity reference. Preserve the person’s natural facial features and overall identity with high accuracy.

Create an ultra-realistic, high-contrast, black-and-white, low-key studio portrait of the reference subject in a quiet moment of musical immersion.

Composition & Framing
Use a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Show the subject in a strict 90-degree right-facing side profile, framed as a lower-chest-up / mid-torso portrait. Keep the subject centered overall, but make him appear smaller in frame, as if photographed from a little farther away.

Leave generous negative space above the head, clearly more headroom than in a typical tight portrait. Also keep moderate open space in front of the face on the right. Make sure the full hair shape, headphones, hood, shoulder, and upper torso are comfortably visible. Do not crop too close.
Pose & Expression
Keep the head in a clean right-facing profile with the chin slightly raised. Eyes gently closed, brow completely relaxed, lips softly and naturally rested together, jaw loose, and facial muscles calm. The expression should feel quiet, immersed, serene, and meditative, not pouty, tense, dramatic, or fashion-posed.

Wardrobe & Headphones
The subject wears premium over-ear wireless headphones with a smooth wide headband, thick matte ear cushions, and large circular metallic ear cups with a clear brushed / spun metal texture.

He wears a white hoodie. The hoodie should look smooth, plain, soft, and clean, with no visible fabric texture. Avoid rough weave or strong cloth grain. The hood rests naturally around the upper back and neck, creating a thick layered collar, with one flat drawstring hanging naturally down the chest.
Lighting
Use dramatic low-key chiaroscuro studio lighting that closely matches the original image.

The main light is a strong hard rim light placed behind and slightly above the subject on the right side. This rim light should create a crisp silver outline along:

the outer hair silhouette

the forehead, nose bridge, lips, and chin edge

the outer metallic edge of the headphone cup

the hoodie collar, shoulder ridge, and upper sleeve
Add only a very weak, highly diffused front-left fill light so the face and hoodie remain visible without becoming flat or bright. The fill should be extremely subtle. Keep the shadows deep and moody. The face should not look evenly lit or front-lit. The original image’s lighting should feel more like a sculpted edge-lit portrait than a standard soft studio portrait.

Background
Use a pure seamless black background with no visible texture, no environment, and no extra elements.

Camera & Detail
Simulate a portrait telephoto lens (85mm–105mm) with f/5.6 to f/8 depth of field so the entire subject stays sharp — including hair texture, skin detail, headphones, hoodie shape, and drawstring. Keep the image crisp and realistic, but do not over-emphasize fabric texture.

Important Constraints
Keep more negative space above the head
Make the subject appear farther from the camera
Keep the subject centered overall
Chin slightly raised
Expression must be soft, calm, and meditative
Lighting must stay dark, sculpted, and rim-light dominant
Do not make the face too bright or too evenly lit
Hoodie must remain smooth and plain without any texture
Do not make it a tight crop
Do not rotate the face toward the camera
Do not add text, logos, watermark, or extra objects

prompts.title: Backlit Monochrome Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 4:5 black-and-white low-key fashion portrait using the uploaded image strictly only for face and identity reference. Preserve the person’s real facial identity, face shape, hairstyle, hair volume, eyebrows, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, facial hair if present, skin tone values in monochrome, and natural expression as accurately as possible.
Create a tight upper-body fashion portrait with the subject placed slightly left of center, face close to the camera, shoulders naturally angled, one shoulder slightly lower and closer to the camera, and the chest filling the lower frame. The head is gently tilted to one side, with direct eye contact toward the camera.
Expression: calm, serious, mysterious, and editorial, with a relaxed mouth, natural face tension, no smile, and no exaggerated emotion. The face should remain mostly hidden in deep shadow, with only subtle highlights revealing the cheekbone, nose bridge, lips, eyes, ear edge, jawline, neck, and hair outline.
Lighting must be dramatic high-contrast black-and-white: strong bright white studio background, very dark foreground silhouette, soft rim light around the hair, ears, neck, and shoulders, deep shadows across the face and clothing, minimal visible facial detail, cinematic low-key contrast, clean highlights, deep blacks, and subtle film grain.
Clothing: plain oversized black crewneck sweatshirt with realistic matte fabric texture, soft folds, dropped shoulder seams, and a premium minimal look. No visible logo, no readable text, no chest graphic, and no accessories unless already present in the uploaded face reference.
Use a premium fashion photography style with a 50mm–85mm portrait lens look, close portrait perspective, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural pores, detailed hair strands, high dynamic range, clean white background, and subtle analog film grain.
Do not add extra objects, logos, readable text, watermarks, cartoon style, plastic skin, overexposed faces, beauty filters, distorted facial features, extra limbs, or AI-generated artefacts.

prompts.title: Split Focus
prompts.prompt:
Create a cinematic vertical 4:5 portrait of the reference person. The subject is shown in a chest up, facing side profile, with the head slightly lowered and the body standing in a calm, introspective pose. The subject should appear mostly as a dark silhouette, with only a subtle rim light defining the hairline, forehead, nose bridge, lips, jawline, and edge of the face.
Use a warm sunset gradient background with deep orange and red tones behind the subject, softly fading into a muted greenish-gray tone near the top. Add soft atmospheric haze, a dreamy glow, and gentle film-like diffusion. Create a long-exposure motion-blur effect with a faint translucent ghost-like duplicate of the head trailing behind the subject, while keeping the main profile readable and emotionally strong.
The composition should be minimal, cinematic, and contemplative, with high contrast, moody lighting, soft focus, shallow depth of field, and an editorial film-photography aesthetic. No text, no logo, no extra objects, no harsh details, no over-sharpening. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Family Silhouette
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image ONLY for face and identity reference of all subjects. Do not alter facial structure, skin tone, age, or likeness. Maintain accurate identity for each person.
Create a 4:5 aspect ratio, high-contrast black-and-white cinematic silhouette portrait of a family (mother, father, and child) in an intimate, emotional composition.

Composition & Pose:
Three subjects in close proximity forming a triangular composition
Child positioned in the center, facing slightly upward to the mother
Mother on one side and father on the other, both gently leaning toward the child
Parents’ faces angled downward toward the child, creating a soft, loving connection
Capture only side profiles / semi-profiles (no full frontal face)

Lighting (CRITICAL):
Strong backlight source (bright circular/oval light) directly behind subjects
Subjects appear as dark silhouettes with soft glowing edge highlights (rim light)
No front lighting — faces remain mostly in shadow
Clean separation between subjects and background using light halo

Style & Mood:
Minimal, emotional, timeless family moment
Deep blacks, bright whites, no mid-tone clutter
Soft gradients around light source, rest pure black
Studio-like controlled environment
Details:
Subtle visible outlines of hair, nose, lips, and clothing edges
Natural posture, not stiff or posed
Keep clothing simple and non-distracting

Text (optional, centered bottom):
“FAMILY” in bold uppercase with wide character spacing
Subtext: “Where life begins & love never ends”

Quality:
Ultra-realistic, sharp edges, cinematic photography, high contrast, 8K feel

Negative Prompt:
color, flat lighting, front-lit faces, smiling directly at camera, cartoon, illustration, blur, distortion, extra people, shoulder crops, bad anatomy

prompts.title: Eternal Silhouette
prompts.prompt:
Use the provided reference images to match the identity, age, and facial features of both subjects. Preserve their natural facial structure, proportions, hairline, and overall likeness. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter their identities in any way. Ensure the silhouettes still reflect the correct face shape and recognizable profile of each subject.
Create a dramatic black-and-white high-contrast silhouette portrait of a couple standing extremely close to each other in an almost-kiss pose.
Composition & Framing
Vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio.
Close-up framing from the chest or shoulders upward. The couple is centered in the frame, facing each other in profile.
Man (left side): Facing right. He has short, neatly styled hair and light stubble, wearing a formal blazer with a collared shirt. His head is slightly tilted downward toward the woman.
Woman (right side): Facing left. She has naturally long, wavy hair with a floral hairpiece positioned on the upper side of her head, small earrings, and an elegant outfit with subtle decorative details. Her head is slightly tilted upward toward the man.
Their noses are almost touching and their foreheads nearly meet. They maintain direct eye contact with each other, creating a romantic and intimate moment.
Lighting & Style
The couple appears as deep black silhouettes against a pure bright white backlit background. Strong rim lighting clearly defines the contours of their faces, hair, and bodies, creating a sharp separation between the subjects and the background.
The image should resemble professional cinematic studio silhouette photography with crisp edges, smooth gradients, and strong contrast. Render the image in high-contrast monochrome with high-key lighting and absolutely no color.
Typography
Place the text centered at the top of the image with clear spacing from the edge.
Title: “ENDLESS LOVE” in a large, elegant serif font.
Subtitle below the title:
“Loved you yesterday, love you still, always have, always will.”
Use a thin, spaced grey font for the subtitle.

prompts.title: Silhouette of a Seeker
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-resolution, ultra-realistic silhouette portrait using the uploaded face as the exact identity reference. Preserve the subject’s true side-profile structure (forehead slope, nose bridge, lip outline, chin and jaw contour, beard placement, and neck anatomy) without alteration, even though facial details remain mostly hidden in shadow.

Pose & Direction
The subject is captured in a strict left-facing side profile. The head is tilted backward, chin lifted high, forming a clear upward gaze. The neck appears elongated, with a faint Adam’s-apple contour. A slightly uneven goatee/beard is visible at the chin in silhouette.

Clothing & Accessories
Baseball cap: Dark navy / deep charcoal tone, curved visor, small top button visible in silhouette
Glasses: Dark-rim glasses or sunglasses with a thin edge highlight
T-shirt: Dark charcoal / near-black, soft fabric with subtle folds
Lighting, Gloss & Color Tone
Use strong backlighting to create a near-solid black silhouette. Add a subtle glossy rim-light sheen along the cap edge, glasses rim, shoulder line, upper sleeve, and chest contour, showing realistic fabric reflection without revealing facial details.

Overall image tone is cool, desaturated, near-monochrome, with deep blacks against a soft white to very light cool-grey background.
Framing & Negative Space (Very Important)
Vertical portrait
Crop from mid-chest upward
Subject placed slightly to the right side of the frame
More negative space on the left side (in front of the face) than on the right
Very large empty space above the head, noticeably more than left or right
Right side space is tighter, left side is open and breathable
Composition feels airy, minimal, and intentional
Background
Clean, plain white/light grey background, no text, no graphics, no overlays.

Mood
Minimal, modern, introspective, cinematic — the upward gaze suggests thought, hope, or vision.
Photographic realism only. No CGI, no illustration, no 3D, no stylization. Identity must remain exact.
